items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Then a woman, her daughter was named Manuella,

ctx.x: So after that, man, I could kind of stay out late. And that went on. The Boozaire(?) Kings, we get popular. Now they want us for house parties. They say, "We could pay you all two dollars if you all come around, you'll all be at the party, all them little girls are gonna be there, and you'all can have all the cake and ice cream you'all want." So we played a couple of them.
Then a woman, her daughter was named Manuella, she was a good-time woman, nice, you know. But she knew all them
